info.title: nano-ocr
info.description: NanoOCR: a pure C# port of the Indra OCR pipeline (line detection, CTC recognition, reading order, layout and markdown). No ONNX Runtime, no OpenCV.

options.name: --out
options.description:
write one file per input (.md, .txt or .jsonl)
--format md|text|json output format (default: md)

options.name: --mode
--model-order
options.description: order text-layer lines with the order model, not the PDF content order

options.name: --no-image-ocr
options.description: on text-layer pages, do not OCR text inside images

options.name: --cores
options.description: cores to use (default: all)

options.name: --dpi
options.description: render resolution for PDFs (default: 200)

options.name: --max-pages
options.description: read at most N pages per file

options.name: --password
options.description: password of encrypted PDFs

options.name: --keep-furniture
options.description: keep page headers and footers in the markdown

options.name: --md-style
options.description:
paddleocr: the markdown PaddleOCR writes (default); reference: the
Python original's (layout_post.page_markdown), byte for byte

options.name: --plain
options.description: PaddleOCR's plain variant: no table styles, captions as text

options.name: --merge-tables
options.description: rejoin tables split across a page break

options.name: --title-levels
options.description: set heading depth from the whole document (numbering and size)

options.name: --no-doc-title
options.description: do not write the document's opening heading as its title (#)

options.name: --math
options.description: write math as LaTeX ($...$); slower on pages with math

options.name: --no-orientation
options.description: do not turn pages upright with the orientation model

options.name: --table-heads
options.description: build tables from the order model's table heads, not geometry

options.name: --no-fusion
options.description: run the models' graphs as written (same results, slower)

options.name: --gemm-256
options.description: use the 256-bit kernels where 512-bit ones would run

options.name: --timings
options.description: print per-page source and time to stderr

options.name: --model-dir
options.description: folder with the models (default: the embedded models)

options.name: --save-img
options.description: also save each page with its blocks and lines drawn over it

options.name: --version
options.description: print the version
